name: Kujou Haruto
source:
[spoiler]A coder and a member of the Japanese research team in charge of the dimensional reactor. The team leader was [url=https://vndb.org/c90046]Konohana Ouka[/url], and the other members were [url=https://vndb.org/c90045]Kamishiro Izana[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c90044]Sumeragi Yuuya[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c90038]Kujou Misaki[/url].

When the reactor was sabotaged and the Catastrophe occurred, the most of his body was absorbed by Astral and become a data in Amaterasu. After thousands years, it has manifested in the Earth as [url=https://vndb.org/c90037]Ragna Nidhogg[/url]. But a small part of Haruto's body, a part of the head and brain, has remained in Earth and was transferred in England along with other team members except [url=https://vndb.org/c90038]Misaki[/url]. One who recovered from it has become [url=https://vndb.org/c90043]Glenfarth von Veratyr[/url].[/spoiler]
